items.summary: CTO disposition: reject all new queue admissions, site-factory tasks, CRO prototypes, telemetry requests, and report-only work this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots and existing measurement and repair work must be resolved first. Preserve only the canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the next implementation after the existing capacity-blocking repair case is completed or justifiably closed. Scope remains CTA hierarchy, disclosure placement, accessibility, responsive layout, deterministic link checks, single-diff rollback, and measurement against the recorded 61-click baseline without revenue or causal-lift claims.

Maintain private-launch and security-sensitive release gates. Existing security and operations evidence is incomplete; do not clear gates, deploy, add dependencies, change credentials or configuration, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external rights outreach. Continue only the canonical read-only evidence work using retained artifacts and authorized metadata.

The proposed three preview-only launch-readiness tasks and CFO report-only baseline are not admitted this cycle. They do not release capacity or improve delivery evidence sufficiently to justify additional queue load. Reconsider only after one active slot is released and existing attention items are reduced.
